Hi Lucy / James,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — really enjoyed hearing how BrightFin plans to use embeddings + our chat endpoints in the advisor workflow. You mentioned wanting to start with a small production pilot (customer-facing) but not being ready to commit to dedicated capacity. I wanted to outline a few realistic pathways for hosted API baseline coverage so you can pick what maps to your finance/process constraints.

High-level options (we can iterate numbers):
- Pay-as-you-go: no monthly guarantee, standard ratecard applies. Good for spikey evaluation but unit cost is highest.
- Soft-monthly guarantee (30-day soft exit): smaller monthly floor with ability to exit with 30 days' notice. Helps lock a predictable unit price without a long-term commitment.
- Time-bound pilot minimum: short fixed minimum (e.g., 3 months) with an activation credit to reduce upfront spend and a path to convert to an annual commit.

To make this concrete, could you share a target pilot budget (ballpark monthly $) or an expected peak qps? Even a range is helpful. Separately, two questions for ops/legal: do you require rollover credits if usage undershoots the floor for the month, and is a 30-day soft-exit acceptable to procurement?

I've attached our latest ratecard for reference (Redwood_ratecard_Q4.xlsx). Monica is cc'd and will scope concrete numbers once you share a target. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call this week to walk options.

Next steps: please reply with a target monthly pilot budget or suggest a time for a call.

Hi Lucy — thanks for the detail and the budget range. We can definitely structure a starter pathway around a sub-$2k floor. Below are two practical proposals that usually map to the legal/finance patterns we see:

Option 1 — Starter soft-floor (recommended for small pilots)
- Minimum: $1,500 / month for 3 months
- Term: 3-month pilot, 30-day soft-exit after pilot ends
- Discount: 40% off list token rates for the pilot months (applied to baseline up to the floor)
- Overage: billed at list rate with 10% unit discount on excess if monthly usage > 120% of floor
- Rollover: unused baseline in a pilot month can be applied once to the next month within the 3-month window (one-time rollover, not cumulative)
- Activation: $500 one-time credit applied on month 1 to reduce initial cash outlay

Option 2 — Short convertable commit (for teams comfortable with faster scale)
- Minimum: $5,000 / month for 6 months
- Discount: 25% off list rates; if you convert to an annual commit within 90 days after pilot, we will apply a retroactive credit equal to 50% of pilot payments toward first year commit (subject to minimum annualization thresholds)

Notes on SLAs & capacity: this is hosted (multi-tenant) so we can't promise Dedicated throughput SLAs, but we do include standard availability and support response time in the SOW.

Attachments and next steps:
- Attached: BrightFin_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW stub) and ratecard (we already attached the ratecard in the first message).
- If Option 1 looks good we can send a short SOW + DocuSign today and enable API keys after countersignature.

Would you like me to put Option 1 into a short SOW that includes the $500 activation credit and the one-time rollover clause? If yes, I'll draft and route for signature.
